posts.name: Belle Sorciere
posts.cooked:
The Scholar used an Oblivaeon shard to make his philosopher's stone. He's turning his flesh literally to metal in that card, hence "Flesh to Iron." That is, as a matter of transmutation. The other Oblivaeon shards we know about augmented others' powers in different ways - the Sentinels for example didn't get transmutation powers similar to the Scholar's from their Oblivaeon shards. 

Baron Blade is wearing an invention on his arm. He did not turn his arm into metal, nor is he transmuting anything. A connection seems unlikely, and just saying they look similar isn't really enough to establish that connection. Contextually, Luminary invents things. Scholar transmutes things. They are different.
